speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you are a newborn with a generalized rash. To help me understand what is going on, can you tell me if the rash appeared all at once or if it started in a specific spot and spread?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-day-old newborn. The newborn was born at term with no complications. The mother had no prenatal care and has a history of gonorrhea treated 4 years ago. The newborn presents with a generalized rash that has been present for 1 day.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that history. The rash appeared suddenly one day after birth in a 4-day-old infant with no prenatal care. Have you noticed any yellow drainage or pus from the baby's eyes?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized erythematous maculopapular rash and pustules. I also have Rash with an erythematous base, Rash over the trunk and extremities, Sparing of the palms and soles.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Gonococcal Conjunctivitis with Disseminated Gonococcal Infection.
